newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-VALENCIA HANG ON AFTER GOALKEEPER SENT OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA HANG ON AFTER GOALKEEPER SENT OFF.

text.p: Valencia won through to the third round of a European competition for the first time in eight years after clinging on for a goalless draw in a scrappy UEFA Cup match against Slavia Prague on Tuesday.

Valencia, 1-0 winners in the first leg, had to fight hard to hang on after losing goalkeeper Andoni Zubizarreta to a controversial red card for hand ball outside the area five minutes into the second half.
The qualification will come as a boost for Valencia, a side that has been disrupted by the transfer of Brazilian forward Romario in recent weeks.
